setup_detail: A private project folder is ready. Choose another folder only when you want to work in an existing repository.
setup_welcome_detail: Choose a project and Pi Agent will open an isolated assistant that can inspect files, make changes and run commands with your approval.
setup_step_workspace_detail: Pick the repository you want this agent to understand.
setup_step_runtime_detail: Wabou prepares the Pi runtime and keeps it isolated.
setup_step_prompt_detail: Ask a question first, or give the agent work to complete.
setup_safety: This folder will be created when the agent starts. You can browse to an existing repository instead.
proxy_scope: Used by Bun/npm package installation and every provider request.
agent_isolation: Each agent owns an isolated Pi RPC process, session and proxy environment.
settings_intro: Configure this agent and the defaults inherited by new agents.
current_agent_detail: Workspace, model and proxy are isolated for this agent process.
language_detail: Choose the interface language for this desktop client.
provider_detail: New agents inherit these values and can override them independently.
proxy_detail: Wabou exports HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and ALL_PROXY before spawning Bun. This covers downloading the Pi npm package and subsequent provider traffic.
runtime_detail: Set WABOU_PI_BIN to bypass package resolution and use a managed Pi installation. A QuickJS-native executor remains a future option.
rename_session_detail: Choose a short name that makes this thread easy to find later.
empty_detail: Start several independent agents, each with its own workspace, provider and network proxy.
starter_explain_prompt: Explain this repository's structure and suggest a good first task.
starter_fix_prompt: Inspect this repository for an important bug and propose a safe fix.
starter_plan_prompt: Help me turn a feature idea into a concrete implementation plan.
queue_follow_up: Add a follow-up while Pi is working…
prompt_placeholder: Ask this agent to work in its repository…
send_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline
delete_agent_detail: Remove this agent and its session references from the desktop workspace.
delete_agent_files_safe: The running process will stop. Original Pi session files and repository files will not be deleted.
